diagram:
flowchart TD
  SCHED["⏰ Weekday 9:45 AM"] --> PICK["📥 Take signals ≥60"]
  PICK --> KELLY["📐 Half-Kelly sizing\nf = wr/avgLoss − lr/avgWin"]
  KELLY --> RISK["🛡️ Deterministic risk gate\nsize caps · exposure · rules"]
  RISK --> PROP["📝 Create trader_proposals\napproval_required mode"]
  PROP --> APPROVE{"Human approves?"}
  APPROVE -->|"Yes"| FILL["💰 Paper fill (or live: acct 605420660 only)"]
  APPROVE -->|"No"| SKIP["⏭️ Skipped / expires"]

SCHED.label: Weekday 9:45 AM
SCHED.description: Runs after research settles. Deterministic — NOT an LLM. This is a Flow, not an AI agent.
SCHED.addReason: Act on fresh signals shortly after open.

PICK.label: Take signals ≥60
PICK.description: Consumes agent_signals with analyst_score ≥ 60 as buy candidates.
PICK.addReason: Score threshold gates which signals become trades.

KELLY.label: Half-Kelly sizing
KELLY.description: Position size from f = win_rate/avg_loss − loss_rate/avg_win, halved, capped at positionSizePct, floored at 2%. Falls back to flat sizing if fewer than 10 closed trades.
KELLY.addReason: Kelly sizes to edge; half-Kelly reduces variance; flat fallback avoids overfitting tiny samples.

RISK.label: Deterministic risk gate
RISK.description: Rule-based checks (size caps, exposure, long-only for new positions) — no LLM. Reasons stored in risk_check_reasons.
RISK.addReason: Safety must be deterministic, never probabilistic.

PROP.label: Create trader_proposals
PROP.description: Emits proposals in approval_required mode. Real orders are never auto-placed.

APPROVE.label: Human approves?
APPROVE.description: The user approves or rejects. Cron can only generate proposals — never approve them.

FILL.label: Paper fill / live
FILL.description: Paper fills always; live orders only ever from account 605420660 (the sole order-placement account), and only when trading_mode is enabled.
FILL.addReason: Single authorized live account; everything else read-only.

SKIP.label: Skipped / expires
SKIP.description: Unapproved proposals expire; the proposal-reminder job nudges you before they do.
